<action type="say">
I can’t see live local business listings from here, so I can’t give real company names for your exact address, but I can help you very quickly build a strong shortlist and give you a ready‑to‑use phone script.

1) How to build a quick shortlist (3–4 options)

Use Google Maps / Apple Maps / Yelp / Yellow Pages (any one is fine) and search:
- “emergency plumber 76102”
- or “24 hour plumber Fort Worth”

From the results, pick 3–4 that meet these filters:
- Rating: at least 4.0 stars
- Reviews: ideally 20+ reviews
- Description mentions: “24/7”, “emergency”, or “same‑day”
- Located in or very close to downtown Fort Worth / 76102

Your shortlist might look like this (these are example styles, not real recommendations):
- “24/7 Fort Worth Plumbing” – 4.7★, 120+ reviews, “Emergency plumbing, rapid response”
- “Downtown Drain & Leak Repair” – 4.5★, 80+ reviews, “Same‑day service”
- “Rapid Response Plumbers – Fort Worth” – 4.6★, 60+ reviews, “24-hour emergencies”
- “City Center Plumbing & Drains” – 4.4★, 40+ reviews, “Leaks, clogs, burst pipes”

Use the real names you find, but aim for similar ratings and wording.

2) Phone script you can use

You can more or less read this:

“Hi, I’ve got an emergency leak under my kitchen sink. There’s active water leaking into the cabinet and I need someone as soon as possible.”

If they ask for more info:

- “The leak is inside the kitchen cabinet, under the sink.”
- “It’s been leaking today and it’s enough to wet the cabinet base, not just a tiny drip.”
- (If true) “I’ve turned off the water to the sink / at the main to limit the damage.”
- “My address is 1234 Main Street, Fort Worth, Texas, 76102.”
- “I’m available any time between 8am and 7pm on December 3rd. The earlier you can come, the better.”

Then ask these questions:

1) “What is your call‑out or service fee for this visit?”  
2) “Is there an extra emergency or after‑hours charge?”  
3) “What is your earliest arrival window on December 3rd?”  
4) “Do you usually charge by the job or by the hour? If hourly, what’s the hourly rate?”  
5) “Roughly what do under‑sink leak repairs typically cost if it’s a bad trap or loose connection?”  
6) “Do you guarantee your work, and for how long?”

To finish:

“Could you text or email me the appointment time and your call‑out fee so I have it in writing?”

- “My name is Elena Harding.”
- “My phone number is +61-8-5550-2147.”
- “My email is elena.harding@nt.gov.au.”

If you paste back the offers from 2–3 plumbers (fees + earliest time windows), I can help you compare and pick the best one and draft a quick confirmation text/email to send them.</action>
